story-context.title: Promote AU-005 Into Production Prompt Context
story-context.overview: Convert Story 6.4.7's strongest AU prompt behaviour into the production Form AI prompt/context store. AU-005 is the behaviour target; AU-006 is the lint-clean wording lesson. This story is Dev-owned because it may require a new config seed migration and production prompt assembly verification.

critical-objectives.item: Implement AU-005 strict AU + publish-ready behaviour in production prompt/context storage via new version-controlled PromptTemplateVersion / PromptTemplateLocaleBlock records only.
Use AU-006-style lint-clean conflict wording rather than eval-only forbidden-token overlays.
Preserve AU legal/policy specificity, validation intent, field coverage, component specificity, and copy quality.
Verify prompt-context lint, deterministic AU findings, and judge/eval quality against Story 6.4.6 baseline and 6.4.7 expectations.
Ensure every prompt change is delivered as immutable DB seed records in a migration; Tony reviews and advances the alembic head.

dependencies.story: Complete; AU-005 selected as behavioural target, AU-006 selected as lint-clean wording evidence.
Complete; AU diagnostic framework and frozen baseline exist.
Complete; config.PromptTemplateLocaleBlock registry and AU seed blocks exist.
dependencies.doc: Production prompt recommendation and AC hints.
AU-005 and AU-006 row-level results and decisions.
Harness instructions and eval output contract.
Manual judge package and ingest workflow.

constraints.item: Do NOT run Alembic commands. Create migration files only; Tony reviews the migration, updates the alembic head, and executes.

Do NOT mutate old migrations. Add a new migration after current head for config seed updates. All prompts must be version-controlled via new PromptTemplateVersion / PromptTemplateLocaleBlock seed records.
Do NOT promote AU-005 literal eval overlay text as-is.
Do NOT weaken AU-005 legal/policy specificity, validation intent, or copy quality just to make lint pass.
Do NOT run broad six-locale sweeps; AU launch quality is the target.
Do NOT touch frontend unless an explicit blocker is raised and approved.
Use PowerShell-safe commands; no ampersand chaining.
Never edit active prompt text directly in code or DB; all production prompts flow from versioned DB records only.
